notes.title: Update 1.0.9 is available!
notes.notes:
Greetings!
Update 1.0.9 is available!

* Added 8 music tracks!
* Fixed the incorrect operation of the "Sound" option. Now the sound is turned on / off in real time.
* Fixed platform exit beyond the monitor (virtual).
* Fixed small bugs on bonus levels.
* The problem with textures on the final video has been resolved.
* Changed the effect of missing some blocks.
* Added SSAO effect.
* Added effects for the death scene.

notes.title: About the situation
notes.notes:
Dear friends!
With steam recently introduced a new rating system, which has negatively affected the popularity of our game.
 During the six weeks since the release of the game - the game has been updated as much as 7 times.
 It introduced a lot of achievements for such a small game, fixes many bugs, increased game performance. Added support for mouse and geymada. Most of the changes were made at the request of the players - who have bought the game.
Our team was not more than one day without working on the game.
All the questions that were asked - I were answered fully and meaningfully.
We also have, there are new plans to update and support the game, the game is not currently popular, although it is worth very little money.
 Huge please dear players: write a review for our games - such what you see fit. We have never and no one is forced to write positive reviews for our game!
Now the game sorely lacking surveys that we believe - very unfair considering the Volume of the work that has been carried out for the benefit of the game.

Thank you in advance and enjoy your game!
